The large necrotic patches with yellow-gold borders in the test image best match Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka at an advanced coalescing stage. The yellow margin is the hallmark of Sigatoka lesions. Panama Disease doesn't fit (no wilting/whole-leaf collapse), and Cordana shows much smaller discrete lesions.
